Questions and answers

Why is PDFLokal free?

I think tools for handling documents should be free. Why would anyone have to pay just to merge a PDF or compress an image?

If I buy you a coffee, do the features become paid?

No. Every feature that exists now stays free for everyone, forever. The coffee helps cover the domain, hosting, and building new features.

Are my files safe?

Very safe. Everything runs right in your browser. Files are never uploaded to any server. Don't believe me? Check the source code yourself, it's all open source.

Will there be a premium tier?

No, and there never will be. PDFLokal is a personal project I opened to everyone, not a business. If a feature ever needs a server (like Word conversion), I'll find a way to keep it free.
